newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Indo-Rama signs US$175 mln loan facility.
newsitem.headline: Indo-Rama signs US$175 mln loan facility.

text.p: PT Indo-Rama Synthetics signed a US$175 million syndicated loan facility in Singapore on Tuesday which will be used for refinancing existing loans as well as general corporate purposes, bank officials said.
The three year facility can be extended for an additional two years at the borrowers request and the lenders' option.
The facility was jointly arranged by Bankers Trust Co, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell (Singapore) Ltd, PT Fuji Bank Internasional Indonesia, HSBC Investment Bank Asia Ltd and ING Barings.
Indo-Rama Managing Director, S.P. Lohia told Reuters the firm exports some 60 percent of its products "and we'd like more international exposure".
